== Transcription notes ==

Notes from transcribing the decklist sheet ([[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2.pdf]]):

* Sheet Jan Westergaard 'Oh No, It's TTO' DS Endor Ops. Inventory Ian/LS wrong; Dark X on sheet.

== Decklist checked against the scan (2026-10-16) ==
Transcribed from the scanned sheet ([[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 p097 Jan Westergard DS.png]]). Deck title on the sheet: ''Oh No, It's TTO''. The old list was a copy of Jesse Reynolds' list; this one is Jan's own sheet. Line 15 reads "Central Core" (linked: [[Death Star: Central Core]]); line 12 "Tatooine (EPI)" (linked: the Coruscant Tatooine). Line 53 Astro Shortage (V) is struck and replaced by Ability, Ability, Ability (V); shield 12 Frozen Dinner (V) is struck, so the deck has 11 shields. Shield 11 is written "Code Clearance (effect)", linked to the Decipher shield; the player may have meant something else. Every shield except Code Clearance is marked V: Allegations, Battle Order, Oppressive Enforcement, Come Here You Big Coward and Fanfare link the December 2006 [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]] printings; Firepower, Resistance, After Her!, Reactor Terminal and Something Special Planned For Them link their Original Virtual Set printings. Leave Them To Me (V) was not on the sheet. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 19:49, 16 October 2026 (UTC)
